[package]
name = "irmin"
version = "1.0.0"
description = "Sophon game downloader"
authors = ["The Elysiae Project"]
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.92.0"

[lib]
name = "irmin"
crate-type = ["lib"]

[dependencies]
futures-util = "0.3"
serde_json = "1"
fast-md5 = "1.0"
prost = "0.14"
hex = "0.4"
thiserror = "2"
sha2 = "0.11"
libc = "0.2"
rustc-hash = "2"
lz4 = "1"
flate2 = "1"
log = "0.4"

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["rt", "rt-multi-thread", "sync", "time", "macros", "io-util", "signal"]

[dependencies.tokio-util]
version = "0.7"
features = ["io", "io-util"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive", "rc"]

[dependencies.reqwest]
version = "0.13"
features = ["stream", "json"]

[dependencies.zstd]
version = "0.13"
features = ["experimental"]

[dependencies.dashmap]
version = "6"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.xxhash-rust]
version = "0.8"
features = ["xxh64"]

[dependencies.zip]
version = "8"
default-features = false
features = ["deflate"]

[target."cfg(not(target_env = \"msvc\"))".dependencies.tikv-jemallocator]
version = "0.7"
optional = true

[target."cfg(not(target_env = \"msvc\"))".dependencies.tikv-jemalloc-ctl]
version = "0.7"
optional = true

[dev-dependencies]
wiremock = "0.6"
criterion = "0.8"
tempfile = "3"

[features]
sophon-profiling = ["dep:tikv-jemallocator", "dep:tikv-jemalloc-ctl", "tikv-jemallocator/stats", "tikv-jemalloc-ctl/stats"]
benchmark = []

[[bench]]
name = "sophon_bench"
harness = false
required-features = ["benchmark"]

[[bin]]
name = "bench_memory"
path = "src/bin/bench_memory.rs"
required-features = ["benchmark"]

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = true
codegen-units = 1
panic = "abort"
strip = true

[profile.dev.package."*"]
opt-level = 2
